# Brain Mechanic: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code 584f89fa23be · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** A repair manual for the mind: look up ADHD, anxiety, narcissism and upbringing patterns, run free self-checks and find tools. Not medical advice.
**Live:** https://brain-mechanic.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/brain-mechanic · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `brain-mechanic/.claude/skills/brainmechanic/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py brainmechanic` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Content is data in `theme/assets/bm-data.js`** (window.BM: SYSTEMS, LIGHTS, CONDITIONS, PATTERNS, SCANS, TOOLS, ADHD).
  Python never parses it whole: `client_code/bm.py` asks `bm-engine.js` for JSON (`BM.json.cards/one/meta/adhd/search/rank/items/score`)
  and caches it, then builds item dicts (`bm.card`, `bm.chip`, `bm.lis`). New entry/check/tool = edit bm-data.js (recipes in the guide);
  a new check id must also go into `SCAN_IDS` in server_code/Logbook.py.
- **JavaScript engines stay in `theme/assets/bm-engine.js`** (unchanged code from the JS version): the lookup engine (stems, synonyms,
  typo tolerance), `BM.rankLights`, `BM.scoreScan` (bands, ASRS shading, attachment dials, factory settings, safety FLAGS), the office
  SVG (Components/Office), gauges (Components/Gauge), the Garage chart (Components/Chart) and the live tool widgets (breath, timer,
  ground, the ADHD pit-crew BM.W.*) mounted by Components/Widget. Widgets call back through `BM.host` (bm.install_host: server calls
  as JSON, toasts, confirm, the account dialog). The worksheet tools (w = 'sheet') are a Python component (Components/Worksheet).
- **Two pages per address** (router._form): `#manual` = Pages/Manual, `#manual/<id>` = Pages/Entry; `#factory/<id>` = Pattern;
  `#toolbox/<id>` = Tool; `#diagnose/scans` = Checks. Addresses are the JS version's, so shared links keep working.
- **Browser storage keeps the old keys** (`brainmechanic.results`, `.lights`, `.wo`, `.adhd.*`, `.theme`): guests' results, the
  lit warning lights and the work-order draft carry over. Garage "Delete everything" clears them (WIPE_KEYS in Pages/Garage).
- RadioButton values come back as text on the App Server: Scan.answer() turns them into numbers before scoring.
- Items carry a `host` (the page) for actions (Lamp → Diagnose.toggle_light, Recent/PlanRow/JournalRow → Garage, Question → Scan).
- A component named `tag` clashes with Anvil's `.tag` attribute: item Labels are called `tag_label`.
- Admins only ever get counts (admin_overview, admin_usage): never logbook contents. The Privacy page promises it.
- app.css = template core + the old _bm/page CSS (status classes aliased to Label roles, list containers aliased to
  `.anvil-role-X > div`) + the Forms layer at the end of the Brain Mechanic block. The conversion script lives outside the repo.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
